page.notes: Right margin carries "Pag. 6.17." and "Et v.lib." with Arabic words (شرح شواهد المغني), transcribed as printed. Arabic in the text (ابن محمد أو أحمد, لا يعرف في العرب, سمي بهذا الاسم قبله الا الثلاثة, أول الانبيا في الخلف وآخرهم) is only partly legible in the scan and is not reproduced with certainty; the last line of the text is cut off by the Arabic line at the foot. Some Greek and Hebrew-like forms in the main text are uncertain. Greek words are printed as Latin words in the text and are marked where doubtful. Several words, especially at line ends, are uncertain and should be checked against the original. The page has a catchword "Z" and a small Arabic word beneath the column.
